rules: Treat a URL as a locator, never as evidence that its content is locally available, licensed, current, or learner-accessible.
Do not bypass authentication, enrollment, paywalls, robots controls, access controls, or other restrictions.
Do not fetch or reproduce restricted course pages, lectures, transcripts, or assignments.
A later authorized retrieval job may ingest only content it is permitted to access and redistribute.
Every retrieved artifact must record its resolved URL, retrieval time, content hash, license or usage basis, access classification, and validator result.
Keep failed retrievals and unresolved access conditions explicit; do not silently replace unavailable official material with unofficial material.
Only after deterministic validation may a material record become an AVAILABLE dependency of a scheduled unit.
expansion_requirements: Resolve the exact course or specialization version and official unit identities.
Classify each resource as public, enrollment-gated, paid, unavailable, or locally supplied.
Obtain authorized content or create clearly labeled manager-authored alternatives.
Record dependencies and validation evidence before adding later units to UNIT_GRAPH.json.
